purpose: Four-view T-pose modeling references; alternative Bloom is an optional design study, not a runtime replacement

jobs.name: sprig
jobs.prompt: Create a precision 3D CHARACTER TURNAROUND REFERENCE SHEET for image-to-3D modeling, based on the supplied character. One character only, four full-body orthographic renders in a strict 2 by 2 grid on pure white. Top left FRONT, top right RIGHT SIDE (profile with face pointing toward image right), bottom left LEFT SIDE (profile with face pointing toward image left), bottom right BACK. Use subtle small gray English labels below each view. Equal square cells, all figures the SAME height and proportions, feet on equal local baselines, ample whitespace and no cropping. No borders, scenery, pedestals, props, camera perspective or three-quarter views. The same physically coherent mesh is rotated, with exactly matching head, petal/leaf count and arrangement, body, hands and feet. Every view uses the SAME neutral T-POSE: short arms extended horizontally sideways from the shoulders, straight and relaxed, legs separated with a clear gap. In profile the arms extend along the camera axis and are naturally foreshortened, not stretched sideways in the image, not hanging down. BACK MUST HAVE NO FACE, no eyes, no mouth; side has only the naturally visible eye, facial features only on the front surface. Soft neutral studio light, sharp clean color, simple smooth rounded high quality toy-like 3D forms, no hard cast shadows, no motion blur. Keep the proportions and recognizable identity of the input. This is a practical consistent modeling reference, not four independently redesigned illustrations. Preserve this exact cheerful lime green leaf sprite design. Large pale green round head, layered medium green pointed leaf crown, central tall leaf, simple shallow veins, tiny green body and leaf collar, short rounded mitten hands and feet. The back of the crown has overlapping green leaf surfaces and the back of the head is blank pale green. Do not add ears, tail or accessories.

jobs.name: bloom-alternative
jobs.prompt:
Create a NEW alternative design of Bloom, the little pink flower game mascot in the supplied reference. This must be a clearly different and more beautiful flower silhouette, not a recreation of the reference's sharp pointed pink leaf fan. Transform the head crown into a CHERRY BLOSSOM / SOFT PEONY: FIVE large broad ROUND scalloped outer petals, soft circular edges, each with a tiny shallow notch at its rounded tip, and five smaller overlapping rounded inner petals framing the face. No pointed petals anywhere. Soft sculptural cupping and gentle folds, no vein lines. Rich blush pink at the petal bases fading gently toward warm peach-pink tips, clearly readable pink, not white or pale washed out. Small central ivory-peach round face with luminous big dark honey-brown eyes, delicate lashes, sweet small open smile, faint rosy cheeks; keep the tiny cream-and-gold forehead flower detail. Tiny simple rose-pink plump body, pink short arms and legs, two small sage-green collar leaves under the head, three smooth petal shapes on torso. No dress, adult anatomy, jewelry, glitter, fine texture, extra accessories or noise. Clean charming high quality satin clay game mascot render, bright neutral studio lighting, no blur, all geometric forms simple enough for easy 3D modeling and animation.

Show this NEW design as a single MODELING TURNAROUND SHEET in a strict 2x2 grid on pure white. TOP LEFT FRONT with arms out straight horizontally in T pose, TOP RIGHT a strict profile with face pointing to IMAGE RIGHT and label RIGHT SIDE, BOTTOM LEFT a strict profile face pointing IMAGE LEFT and label LEFT SIDE, BOTTOM RIGHT BACK with no face or eyes and label BACK. All four are exactly the same character and same neutral T pose physically rotated, same head thickness, same five outer rounded petals and five inner petals, identical sizes, equal baselines within cells, full body visible with generous margins. In side views the arms point along the camera axis and are foreshortened. Both feet separated with a gap in front/back. Back view shows the coherent reverse surfaces of the round blossom petals around a simple pink back of the head, no duplicated forehead flower. Use shallow flower crown thickness, not a spherical hair helmet. Small gray labels, no borders or scenery. Make the front and back flower silhouettes agree. The unmistakable new visual feature is the FIVE BROAD ROUND scalloped petals replacing the original many sharp pointed petals.
